name: Arcon PAM Provider
description: A Keyfactor PAM Provider plugin supporting credential retrieval from Arcon.

Parameters.Name: ApiHost
Parameters.Description: The host URL for the Arcon API, including the protocol (e.g., https://api.arcon.com).

Parameters.Name: ApiUsername
Parameters.Description: The username for the Arcon API.

Parameters.Name: ApiPassword
Parameters.Description: The password for the Arcon API.

Parameters.Name: AssetUsername
Parameters.Description: The username for the asset in the Arcon system. The integration will retrieve the password associated with the username and alias.

Parameters.Name: AssetAlias
Parameters.Description: The alias for the asset in the Arcon system. The integration will retrieve the password associated with the alias and username.
